main.description: Baien-MX (ADR 2605101000) — train per-modality 1.58-bit projectors + the shared cross-modal fusion block on RisingWave-native multimodal samples (v_training_multimodal_sample snapshot). All NEW blocks are BitNet QAT (1.58-bit). Trunk frozen for v0. Modalities are explicit: caller declares which non-text branches to activate; text is always present.

baseModel.description: BitNet trunk HF id; defaults to microsoft/bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T-bf16.

modalities.description: Non-text branches to train. Text is implicit and always active.

fusionLayerIndex.description: Trunk layer at which to insert the fusion block. Default 15 = L/2 for the 30-layer 2B trunk.

trunkFrozen.description: Freeze the BitNet trunk during training. Default true for v0.

loraOverFirst4Layers.description: Optional v1: per-modality rank-≤16 LoRA over the trunk's first 4 layers. Default false.

learningRate.description: Default LR shared by projectors that do not appear in perModalityLearningRates.

perModalityLearningRates.description: JSON-encoded {modality: lr} override map. Stored as a string because AT Lexicon does not allow free-form object values.

projectorCheckpoints.description: JSON-encoded {modality: checkpointVertexId} map, one row per trained projector (kind=baien-mx-projector-{modality}).
